Aisha Patel: Hey folks — drafting a compact "first 7 days" manager guide for new hires (PM track). Trying to keep it practical: what absolutely needs to be in the manager's checklist for week 0/1?

Liam Chen: Definitely access checklist up top. AD groups, GitHub team, CI creds, Slack channels. If any infra tickets needed, get them in day 0.

Rita Gomez: +1 access. Also schedule 30/60/90 expectations chat in the first week (short, set goals).

Samir Rao: Suggested cadence I use:
```
Day 0: HR + IT access, paperwork
Day 1: Team intro + product overview
Day 2: Dev environment + small starter task
Day 3: Shadowing + docs deep dive
Day 4: First async small deliverable
Day 5: 1:1 recap + 30/60/90 draft
```
Keep it flexible per role.

Aisha Patel: Love that — can we also flag who to ping for common blockers? e.g., infra-oncall, devex, security signoffs.

Liam Chen: Make a small table mapping blocker -> person/team. Example: 'build fails' -> eng-ci, 'VCS access' -> devops-oncall, 'SaaS credentials' -> IT-Support.

Rita Gomez: Add a manager prompt for the first 1:1: 1) how do you like to be onboarded? 2) blockers we can remove now 3) 30/60/90 expectations + success signals.

OnboardBot: Hey Aisha — added the new "first-7-days" template to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/onboarding/first-7-days-template (editable). Use the "manager-fill" copy. :white_check_mark:

Samir Rao: One more practical tip — include a tiny starter ticket in the codebase that touches CI/deploy. Helps verify end-to-end access without pressure.

Aisha Patel: Great points. I'll fold these into the doc: access checklist, owner map, daily skeleton, first-1:1 prompts, sample starter task, and a lightweight 30/60/90 template. Will ping when it's ready for review. :sparkles:

Liam Chen: Happy to review — ping me once it's live.

Rita Gomez: I'll add the manager 1:1 prompts to People Ops notes.

Aisha Patel: Thanks team!"
